scope: Working-tree actual local acceptance data files and native readonly template verification. Acceptance basis, OCI identity and authority/fence facts are explicitly controlled fixtures.
limitations: No real durable physical fence, writer drain, Linux container, gVisor, quota/network provider, enterprise identity or target-filesystem power-loss drill.
The adapter reconstruction test reuses the controlled in-memory authority; it does not demonstrate physical-authority restart durability.
MATERIALIZED is data evidence only, not a full READY proof, actual service health, Release, T5, publication or export.
Only trusted declarative COPY_SAME_SCHEMA for the pinned template is implemented; arbitrary SQL/scripts and schema upgrades remain unavailable.
Build 1 and interrupted files-1 inputs omit templates; files-2 and template-1 include the final template source. No retroactive initial template fingerprint is asserted.
Files-1 was deliberately interrupted after diagnosed readonly header failures; its exit code and partial output are retained and it is not counted as a completed suite.
A temporary test filename collision is corrected by restoring the exact HEAD blob and using a distinct file; files-2 runs both cases.
No root pnpm check pipeline, real browser suite, clean checkout, independent review or product gate acceptance is claimed.
